packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.assert@12: Takes a value, an error type string, and a message. If the value is falsy, it throws a `RuleError` built from the type and message; otherwise it returns nothing and narrows the value's type via the assertion signature.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.computeScore@38: Takes a rule and returns a number: the sum of `OP_SCORES` for each condition's op, where an op with no score contributes 0 and is logged. If every condition's op is one of is, isNot, isapprox, oneOf, or notOneOf (including when there are no conditions), the sum is doubled; otherwise the plain sum is returned.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule._rankRules@63: Takes an array of rules and returns a new array sorted by computed score ascending, with ties broken by ascending string comparison of rule ids, so the result is identical regardless of input order. The input array is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.rankRules@87: Takes an iterable of rules, partitions them by `stage` into 'pre', 'post', and all other stages (treated as normal), ranks each partition with `_rankRules`, and returns a new array concatenating pre, then normal, then post.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.migrateIds@112: Takes a rule and an id mapping, and mutates the rule in place: for id-type conditions with `is`/`isNot` it sets `value` (and `unparsedValue`) to the mapped `rawValue` or `rawValue` itself when unmapped, and for `oneOf`/`notOneOf` it sets `value` to the deduplicated mapped list and `unparsedValue` to a copy of it. For id-type actions with op `set` it sets `value` to the mapped `rawValue`. `rawValue` is never modified, and a falsy mapping falls back to the raw value.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.iterateIds@163: Takes a list of rules, a field name, and a callback, and invokes the callback with each rule and matching id value, returning nothing. For each rule in order, it passes id-type conditions on that field with ops is, isNot, oneOf, or notOneOf; if the callback returns a truthy value, the rule's remaining conditions and actions are skipped and iteration moves to the next rule. It then passes `set` id-type actions on that field, where a truthy return stops only that rule's action checks.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseRecurDate@220: Takes a recurrence config object and returns `{ type: 'recur', schedule }`, where `schedule` is an `RSchedule` built from the config's rrules with `skipWeekend` and `weekendSolve` (from `weekendSolveMode`) stored in its data. Any error thrown during conversion is rethrown as a `RuleError` with type 'parse-recur-date' and the original message.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseDateString@239: Takes a value and returns null if it is not a string or is not a valid date at its length. A 10-character string is validated as a full ISO date, a 7-character string as a year-month (validated by appending '-01'), and a 4-character string as a year (validated by appending '-01-01'); valid input returns `{ type, date }` with the original string unchanged. Any other length returns null.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.parseBetweenAmount@268: Takes an object with `num1` and `num2`, and returns `{ type: 'between', num1, num2 }` when both are of JavaScript type number, otherwise null. The values are passed through unchanged, with no range or NaN check.

packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.execNonSplitActions@15: Takes an array of actions and a transaction, runs each action's exec on that same transaction object in order, and returns that object (mutated in place, not a copy).
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.getSplitRemainder@21: Takes an array of split transactions, groups them and runs recalculateSplit on the result, returning the error's difference when the split does not balance and 0 when it does. Does not mutate its input.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.execSplitActions@26: Takes child actions (those with a split index) and a parent transaction, converts the parent into a split transaction, and creates split slots as needed so each action's split index+1 has a slot. It copies the parent's amount, notes, payees, account, balance and prefetch flag into parent_* fields of each slot, runs each action on its slot, sets fixed-percent splits to round(remainder × value/100), then divides the remaining amount evenly among remainder splits with the rounding leftover added to the highest-indexed remainder split. It removes the reserved slot at index 1 and returns recalculateSplit(groupTransaction(...)) for the resulting transactions.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.execActions@103: Takes a list of actions and a transaction, partitions actions into parent actions (no truthy splitIndex) and child actions (truthy splitIndex), and computes the split count as the maximum splitIndex plus one (with a missing index treated as 0). It applies the parent actions to the transaction first; if the split count is 1 or the result is a child transaction, it returns that result, otherwise it returns execSplitActions applied to the child actions and that result.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.constructor@133: Takes an object with optional id, optional stage, conditionsOp, conditions and actions, stores id and conditionsOp, sets stage to null when absent, and converts each condition and action definition into Condition and Action instances, preserving their order.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.evalConditions@157: Returns false when the rule has no conditions. Otherwise returns true if some condition evaluates true (when conditionsOp is 'or') or if every condition evaluates true (for any other conditionsOp), evaluating conditions against the given object without modifying it.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.execActions@168: Runs the rule's actions on a shallow copy of the given object and returns a new object containing only the keys whose resulting values are not strictly equal to the original object's values. The input object is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.exec@181: Returns the changes produced by execActions when evalConditions passes for the given object, and null when the conditions do not pass.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.apply@189: Calls exec on the object and returns a new object that merges the original object with the returned changes (no changes if exec returned null); the input object is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.getId@194: Returns the rule's id, or undefined if none was provided.
packages/loot-core/src/server/rules/rule.Rule.serialize@198: Returns a RuleEntity containing the rule's id, stage, conditionsOp, and the serialized form of each condition and action in their existing order.

packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resetState@65: Replaces the module-level `allRules` with an empty Map and creates new firstchar (on `imported_payee`) and payee indexers, discarding any previously indexed rules.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.invert@76: Returns a new object in which each entry's key and value are swapped, built with `Object.fromEntries`, so a colliding value keeps the later entry. The input is not mutated.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.fromInternalField@87: Returns a shallow copy of the object with `field` replaced by its public name from the inverted schema map, or left unchanged if no mapping exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.toInternalField@94: Returns a shallow copy of the object with `field` replaced by its internal column name from the schema map, or left unchanged if no mapping exists.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseArray@101: Returns the input as an array, JSON-parsing it first if it is a string, and throws a `RuleError` of type 'internal' if parsing fails or the value is not an array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.parseConditionsOrActions@115: Returns an empty array for a falsy input; otherwise parses the input with `parseArray` and maps each item through `fromInternalField`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.serializeConditionsOrActions@119: Maps each item through `toInternalField` and returns the JSON string of the resulting array.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.makeRule@170: Builds a `Rule` from the converted input, returning null and logging a warning if a `RuleError` is thrown and rethrowing any other error. On success it remaps the rule's ids with `migrateIds` using the current mappings and returns the rule.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.loadRules@190: Resets state, then loads non-tombstoned rules with non-null conditions and actions from the database, converting legacy stages 'cleanup' and 'modify' to 'pre'. Each rule that builds successfully is added to `allRules` and both indexers, and any previous sync listener is removed before a new one is registered.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRules@219: Returns a new array containing the rules currently held in `allRules`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.insertRule@224: Validates the rule (requires conditions and actions, a stage of 'pre', 'post' or null, and a conditionsOp of 'and' or 'or') and inserts it with a UUID, returning the result of `db.insertWithUUID`. Validation failures throw.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateRule@231: Validates the rule in update mode, checking stage and conditionsOp only when those keys are present, then persists it with `db.update` and returns the result.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.deleteRule@236: Returns false without deleting if any schedule references the rule id; otherwise deletes the rule from the database and returns true.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.onApplySync@252: Applies synced changes to `rules` by removing tombstoned rules from `allRules` and both indexers, and for other rules replacing any previous indexed entry with the rebuilt rule. If any mapping table changed, it re-runs `migrateIds` on every in-memory rule.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRuleIdFromScheduleId@293: Returns the `rule` value of the schedule with the given id, or null if no such schedule exists or its rule is empty.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getAllRuleIdsFromSchedules@304: Returns the non-empty rule ids of all schedules, excluding the given id. The result is not de-duplicated, so it may contain repeated ids.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.runRules@323: Applies the ranked candidate rules to a transaction in sequence and returns the transaction with their changes. Missing `payee` or `category` values are treated as null during evaluation and removed from the result if still null, and a schedule's own rule runs unconditionally while other schedule-linked rules are skipped. The running balance is fetched at most once and only when a rule that reads it is about to run, and the category group is refreshed after each rule.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionSpecialCases@460: Returns falsy input unchanged. For an `is` condition on a null category it returns an AND of that condition with `transfer is false` and `parent is false`, for an `isNot` condition on a null category it returns an AND with `parent is false`, and otherwise returns the condition unchanged.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.conditionsToAQL@493: Converts each condition (instances or plain objects) to an AQL filter, dropping invalid conditions and collecting their error types, and optionally applies the special-case expansion first. It returns `{ filters, errors }`, with recurring date `is` conditions expanded to at most `recurDateBounds` occurrences.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.applyActions@755: Parses the actions into `Action` instances and returns null if any fail. It then prepares the transactions (computing balances only when an action references them), prefetches `BALANCE_OF` values, executes and ungroups the actions, finalizes each transaction, and passes the results to `batchUpdateTransactions`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRulesForPayee@830: Returns the ranked, de-duplicated rules whose payee-indexed ids include the given payee id.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getIsSetterRules@841: Generator that yields serialized rules in the given stage that have exactly one `set` action on `actionField` and exactly one `is` or `isNot` condition on `condField`, further filtered by `condValue` and `actionValue` when those are defined.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getOneOfSetterRules@868: Generator that yields serialized rules in the given stage that have exactly one `set` action on `actionField` and exactly one `oneOf` condition on `condField`, where `condValue` must appear in the condition's value array and `actionValue` must equal the action value when those are non-null.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updatePayeeRenameRule@896: If a pre-stage rule already sets the payee from `imported_payee` via `oneOf`, it merges the non-empty `fromNames` into that condition's values, updates the rule, and returns its id. Otherwise it inserts a new pre-stage rule mapping those names to `to` and returns the result of `insertRule`.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getProbableCategory@932: Counts the non-empty categories among the transactions and returns the category with the highest count if that count is at least 3, otherwise null. Ties resolve to the category first encountered, and an empty array throws.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.updateCategoryRules@952: For each payee among the given transactions whose five most recent learnable, non-parent transactions include one of the given transactions and have a probable category, updates existing 'is payee' category-setting rules whose value differs. If no such rule exists and no 'oneOf' rule already sets that category, it creates a new rule. It does nothing for an empty input.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.getRunningBalanceBeforeTransaction@1072: Returns the sum of amounts of non-parent transactions in the given account that precede the transaction, meaning earlier dates or the same date with an earlier sort order, excluding the transaction itself. It returns 0 when the sum is null.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prefetchBalanceOfForTransaction@1114: Collects the distinct `BALANCE_OF` account literals from the formulas and returns a Map from each literal to the running balance before the transaction for its resolved account, or 0 when the literal does not resolve to an account.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.actionsReferenceBalance@1146: Returns true if any action's `template` or `formula` option string contains the word `balance`, matched case-insensitively. `BALANCE_OF(...)` does not count.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.prepareTransactionForRules@1158: Returns a copy of the transaction with `payee_name`, `_account`, `_account_name`, `balance` and `category_group` populated from the matching records, where they exist. `balance` is 0 unless `includeBalance` is set and the transaction has an account, in which case it is the running balance before the transaction.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.resolvePayeeNameForRules@1210: When the transaction has a `payee_name` key and `payee` equals 'new', it sets `payee` to the id of the payee with that name, inserting the payee if none exists, or to null if the name is empty. Otherwise it does nothing, and it mutates the object in place.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.refreshCategoryGroupIfChanged@1239: If the transaction's category equals `lastCategoryId`, it returns that value unchanged. Otherwise it sets `category_group` from the new category's group, or deletes it when there is no category, and returns the current category id.
packages/loot-core/src/server/transactio.finalizeTransactionForRules@1258: Resolves a pending 'new' payee if `payee_name` is present, then mutates and returns the transaction with the synthetic fields `payee_name`, `balance`, `category_group`, `_balanceOfPrefetched` and the `parent_*` fields removed. Subtransactions have `balance`, `_balanceOfPrefetched` and the `parent_*` fields removed.
